deferred_outcome_polarity_pressure.next_reopen_condition: Reopen only when another source-grounded cross-industry case provides enough evidence to type implication polarity independently of semantic comparability, or when the existing typed relation causes a demonstrated researcher/product failure rather than mere interpretive inconvenience.
